name: Nine Hours Shinjuku-North
notes: Clean, minimalist capsule hotel with separate male/female floors. Shower rooms, lockers, toiletries included. Three-minute walk from Shinjuku Station.

name: K's House Tokyo (Hostel)
notes: Long-running backpacker favourite with dorms and private rooms, a lively lounge, and free Wi-Fi. A block from Kuramae station.

name: Wise Owl Hostels River Tokyo
notes: Design-forward riverside hostel with a quiet pod-style dorm option, rooftop bar, and a co-working-feel lounge.

name: APA Hotel Shinjuku-Kabukichō Tower
notes: Classic Japanese business hotel — compact rooms but reliable, rooftop onsen, walking distance to Golden Gai and Shinjuku Station.

name: Richmond Hotel Premier Asakusa International
notes: Richmond is the best of the business-hotel tier — larger rooms than APA / Toyoko Inn, nice bathrooms, Skytree view rooms available.

name: Hotel Gracery Shinjuku
notes: Famous for the giant Godzilla head on the roof. Comfortable rooms, central Shinjuku, reliable mid-tier choice for a first trip.

name: Shibuya Granbell Hotel
notes: Boutique design, rooftop bar, five minutes from the Scramble Crossing. Best for couples and solo travellers who want nightlife access.

name: Dormy Inn Ōnyado Nono Asakusa
notes: Ryokan-style business hotel with large shared baths (onsen-style), yukata provided, and the free late-night ramen that made Dormy Inn a cult favourite.

name: Hoshinoya Tokyo
notes: Urban luxury ryokan with a rooftop open-air onsen (real hot-spring water, drawn from 1,500 m deep). Tatami rooms, kaiseki dinner, impeccable omotenashi.

name: Park Hyatt Tokyo
notes: Iconic hotel from 'Lost in Translation'. 52nd-floor New York Bar has unchanged views; reopens after a long refurbishment in 2026.

name: Aman Tokyo
notes: Contemporary Japanese minimalism over the top 6 floors of the Otemachi Tower. Soaring lobby, sunken garden, 30-metre pool with Imperial Palace views.

name: The Tokyo EDITION, Toranomon
notes: Ian Schrager's Tokyo address. Dress-up lobby scene, Blue Room bar on 31F with Tokyo Tower views, and the best jazz programming of any Tokyo hotel.
